title: Obligation and duty: tener que and deber

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the difference between *tener que* and *deber* from B1 Unit 4. *Tener que* + infinitive says that something was necessary: there was no choice. *Deber* + infinitive says what someone thinks should be done.

items.spanish: Los nuevos gobiernos tuvieron que organizar el Estado.
items.english: The new governments had to organise the state.

items.spanish: También tuvieron que buscar dinero para las reformas.
items.english: They also had to find money for the reforms.

items.spanish: Los líderes decían que el Estado debía repartir la tierra.
items.english: The leaders said that the state should share out the land.

items.spanish: Los críticos decían que el Estado no debía controlar tanto la economía.
items.english: The critics said that the state should not control the economy so much.

sections.content: Keep *que* after *tener*: *tuvieron que organizar*, never *tuvieron organizar*. *Deber* takes no *que* or *de* before the infinitive: *debía repartir*.
